Name: No Clop If It's Not a Horse it Shouldn't Gallop
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
This is a simple mod to silence the Galloping noises when you ride your horse replacement without disturbing other parts of the game.

Install Smapi
Install Custom Music and anything it needs
Install PYTK... if you haven't already
Place THIS mod in your mods folder
Enjoy.

Wav file is a blank file I made from 1 second of silence from my FL Studio.

Downloads.Description: Removes the Galloping for the Horse.  Perfect to make replacements that don't clop not clop.
